# Alton Takeyasu 

 

### Tenure

1991 – 2025

### Signature

Alton Takeyasu is an industrial designer who has worked with Mattel from 1991 to 2025. Prior to working at Mattel, he was a designer at Kenner Toys from 1984 to 1991. Takeyasu was responsible for all licensed entertainment-based properties and internally-developed intellectual properties produced by Mattel and was also involved in the design of various full-sized Hot Wheels car designs as well as various lines of action figures. He was inducted into the Model Car Hall of Fame in 2019. He was most recently part of the Mattel Creation Station, a small team supporting all Mattel design teams with "innovation, creative solutions and technical expertise"; he retired in March 2025.
